# Pmi043 — Lower-case relation names where RP requires lower-case keywords

## Description

Relation `name` values (e.g. on `geometric_tolerance_relationship`) use upper or mixed case where RP requires lower-case keywords (`'composite'`, `'all around'`, etc.).

## Reproducer recipe

`geometric_tolerance_relationship('Composite', t1, t2)` with capital C.

## Expected kernel behavior

Case-insensitive accept on read; emit lower-case on write; warn.
